meta.title: Weather Metrics: Production Target Data Flow

nodes.label: Sensors
nodes.explanation: Devices retry on timeout, so every downstream write must be idempotent. Readings carry event time, which can be late or out of order.

nodes.label: Ingest API
nodes.explanation: Stateless gateway (API Gateway + Lambda, or FastAPI replicas). Acks only after the record is durably appended to the log.

nodes.label: Event log
nodes.explanation: Append-only, replicated, partitioned by sensor_id. Absorbs bursts, decouples producers from consumers and allows replay. In the prototype this role is played by the Postgres commit.

nodes.label: Raw archive
nodes.explanation: Immutable copy of every raw reading. Any derived store can be rebuilt from it.

nodes.label: Time-series DB
nodes.explanation: Queryable hot store, partitioned by time, with retention. Writes are idempotent upserts keyed by (sensor_id, metric, ts).

nodes.label: Rollup job
nodes.explanation: Stream or scheduled job producing hourly aggregates so long-range queries read hundreds of rows, not millions. avg = sum / count.

nodes.label: Query API
nodes.explanation: Reads hourly rollups for long ranges and raw rows for short or recent ranges. Scales with read replicas and caching.

cards.title: Durability
items: Ack only after a durable append
Log is the system of record; stores are derived

cards.title: Correctness
items: Event time vs processing time: keep received_at
Late and out-of-order readings are expected

cards.title: Prototype mapping
items: Ingest API, log and TSDB collapse into FastAPI + one Postgres
Broker, archive and rollups are next steps
